text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Arab journalists condemn Turkish invasion of northern Iraq.
- Vice-President Taha Yassin Ramadan says oil contracts with France, Russia and China are steps toward ending embargo on Iraq.
- New shiploads of rice, wheat and vegetable oil bought under the oil-for-food deal reach Um Qasr port in southern Iraq.
- Iraqi football team to play with Pakistani counterpart on Friday within the Asian 1997 World Cup preliminaries.
- Editorial condemning the U.N. Special Commission in charge of destroying Iraq's weapons of mass destruction.
(The above except the editorial were carried by IRAQ and QADISSIYA)
- The highway leading to the Syrian border is ready for trade and travel.
- Editorial criticising U.N. arms inspectors for trying to enter three Iraqi security sites.
